title: Existence of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism
statement: For a Noetherian scheme T and a prime ell invertible on T, and n,d natural numbers, there exists a morphism from realization T ell n of finiteSheaf T ell n d to quotientLine T ell n d satisfying GeneratorCompatible: on every compatible lifted root generator its value is the projected integral tensor with the prescribed constant scalar. No invertibility is asserted.

source.place: Step 2: Existence of the normalized integral Tate quotient morphism

proof.text: Construct the projected tensor map on the compatible primitive-root covering, using the inverse-limit scalar coordinates and finite residue map. The map is balanced in coefficients, descends through tensor and sheafification, agrees on overlaps after a change of primitive roots, and glues. The unit handles d=0.

theorem tateTensorQuotient_generator_map
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (n d : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n d) ⟶ quotientLine T ell n d,
      GeneratorCompatible T ell n d f
